responsibility: This file contains the compiler-proper side of GCC option handling that depends on global state and front-end/backend integration rather than the shared parser core. It wires together the default option handler set for language, common, and target options; diagnoses options valid for other languages; tracks input filenames and deferred unknown -Wno-* warnings; drives decode_options and default-mask decoding for the active front end; and processes deferred common options whose effects require initialized compiler state, such as dump controls, register fixing, plugin loading, prefix maps, random seeds, stack-limit settings, sanitizer section/shadow configuration, and pass enable/disable requests.
